Nested fields consume schema class registration, declared-field collection, only/exclude propagation, and class-name resolution contracts.

notes: Task source and tests are unchanged; only import/bootstrap overlays are applied.

problem_statement:
Restore the public marshmallow schema, field, validator, decorator, and error behavior exercised by the scoped Commit0 tests without modifying the tests.

The registry/declaration layer must implement schema class registration, declared-field collection, Meta options, inheritance, ordering, and nested class-name resolution. The field/validation layer must implement field binding, serialization, deserialization, defaults, missing/null handling, validators, type conversion, and utility helpers. The schema processing layer must consume those contracts to implement load/dump, many/partial/unknown handling, hook decorators, nested schemas, error storage, and custom error handling.

The v0.3 evaluator intentionally excludes tests/test_version_attributes.py because direct checkout execution lacks installed distribution metadata for importlib.metadata.version("marshmallow"). The initial benchmark source is the stripped Commit0-style ref origin/commit0_combined, plus checksum-recorded bootstrap overlays that only make public tests collectable.
